meta.title: Implement NIS2 with guidance: weekly, 30 minutes
meta.description: You know the NIS2 steps and would rather not run them alone. We work through the requirements with you once a week. Platform free and open source, guidance optional and cancellable monthly.

hero.headline: We walk you through NIS2. Point by point.
hero.subhead: You know NIS2 applies to you and you would rather not carry the implementation alone. We sit down with you for 30 minutes once a week and work through the requirements in order. The platform stays free and open source, the guidance is optional.
hero.roadmapLink: Already know the steps and want to start on your own? Here is the roadmap.
hero.trust: Made in Cologne. Hosted in Germany.

process.heading: How the guidance works
process.step1Body: One fixed slot a week. No project month, no endless alignment loops. We take the next item on your roadmap and get it done together.
process.step2Title: We lead, your IT lead implements
process.step2Body: Your personal effort as managing director is about three hours a year, then approval and oversight under Article 20 NIS 2 (in Germany § 38 BSIG) is done. Four obligations under Article 21 are fixed, the rest scales with your risk and is proportional. The operational part, the asset inventory, risk register, suppliers and the ten measures, is handled by your team.
process.step3Body: Your data, the audit trail and the evidence are yours. The platform is open source. If you want to continue without us, export everything and take it with you.

comparison.heading: What each is for
comparison.intro: We do not run anyone else down. Each option has its place. Here is the honest read so you know whether we fit you.
comparison.consultants: A consultant does the work for you and takes real accountability. Worth it if you have the budget and no one in-house to own NIS2 long term. The knowledge does leave with the consultant, though.
comparison.fullService: Full-service GRC platforms cover many frameworks at once and are built for large organizations with their own GRC team. Strong if that is exactly what you need and the budget is there.
comparison.intlPlatforms: International platforms are polished and fast for common certifications. Strong if you certify internationally and English as the primary language fits.
comparison.nisd2: nisd2.eu is free and open source, EU-hosted. One standard, done to depth. Everything exportable, no lock-in. What we do not do: no full-service hand-holding, no phone support walking you through it step by step. You need someone in-house who owns NIS2. That is exactly who this is built for.

features.heading: What we work through with you

obligations.title: The obligations from Article 21 NIS2
obligations.description: Every duty broken into structured forms with clear instructions. No compliance background needed: you answer the questions, we do the mapping.

evidence.title: Evidence and audit trail
evidence.description: Documents, sign-offs and a tamper-evident audit trail build themselves from your work. Everything timestamped, ready for the audit.

deadlines.title: Deadlines and reporting
deadlines.description: Registration, the incident reporting cascade under Article 23 (24 hours, 72 hours, one month) and training renewals. Every deadline tracked, nothing slips.

bsiRegistration.title: Registration with the authority
bsiRegistration.description: Guided preparation for registration under Article 27, with all required documents and a pre-flight checklist.

faq.heading: Common questions
faq.a1: Yes. The platform is free and open source. We earn from guided implementation and training, not from the software and not from your data. You can inspect the code at github.com/NISD2.
faq.a2: We work out the scope in the intro call, cancellable monthly, no lock-in. We first look together at whether you need guidance at all, or whether the free platform and the roadmap are enough on their own.
faq.q3: We already have ISO 27001. Do we still need this?
faq.a3: ISO 27001 covers many of the technical and organisational measures NIS2 also asks for. NIS2 adds obligations an ISMS alone does not cover: registration with the national authority under Article 27, the incident reporting cascade under Article 23, and demonstrable management training under Article 20 NIS 2 (in Germany § 38 BSIG). Those are exactly the gaps we work through with you.
faq.a4: Your personal effort as managing director is about three hours a year: one training, a few signatures. The operational part is handled by your IT lead on an ongoing basis. How fast the baseline is in place depends on how well your asset inventory is already maintained. The roadmap shows the realistic effort per step.
faq.a5: In Germany. Encrypted in transit and at rest, with role-based access and a full audit trail. Details are in the Trust Center.
faq.q6: What happens if we stop the guidance?
faq.a6: You keep using the platform for free, or you export your data and leave. The guidance is cancellable monthly, the software is open source. No lock-in.

sources.body: Sources and transparency: NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555, BSIG, CIR 2024/2690, ENISA Technical Implementation Guidance. Open source, hosted in Germany, GDPR-compliant. This page is structured guidance and is not legal advice. Operational implementation is handled by your IT lead or CISO.
